name: hackintosh-skills
description: 黑苹果（OpenCore）技能集：EFI 配置审查与维护（含 BIOS/驱动/系统升级/选择器主题）、机型切换与三码。
description_en: Hackintosh (OpenCore) skill collection: EFI configuration audit & maintenance (BIOS, drivers, OS upgrades, boot-picker theming) plus SMBIOS model switching and board serials.

plugins.name: opencore-config-audit
plugins.description: 审查、修改与维护黑苹果的 OpenCore EFI 配置与驱动安装：BIOS/UEFI 审查、逐键对照官方文档、ACPI/SSDT 巡检、kext 精简、引导日志与启动耗时取证、系统大版本升级（含网卡 kext 的 MinKernel/MaxKernel 版本分流）、磁盘屏蔽，以及 NVIDIA / Intel 无线 / MediaTek / 博通网卡、AppleALC 声卡、HiDPI、Intel 睿频、内存定制、SMBIOS 三码等驱动与硬件特性，以及启动界面外观（OpenCanopy 主题：图标集、PickerAttributes、Flavour、标签/字体/音频/背景）。
plugins.description_en: Audit, edit and maintain a hackintosh OpenCore EFI configuration and its driver installs: BIOS/UEFI settings audit, per-key verification against the official docs, ACPI/SSDT review, kext trimming, boot-log and boot-timeline forensics, major macOS upgrade planning (including per-Darwin-version kext gating with MinKernel/MaxKernel), disk masking, plus NVIDIA / Intel WiFi / MediaTek / Broadcom cards, AppleALC audio, HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost, memory injection SMBIOS/serials, and OpenCanopy boot-picker theming.

plugins.name: opencore-smbios-switch
plugins.description: 黑苹果（OpenCore）机型切换与三码的完整流程：判断该不该换机型、换机型与内置 USB 图的耦合冲突、board-id 变化带来的系统卷重建、CPUFriendDataProvider 必须同步重做、序列号/MLB/UUID 生成与三类判据、ROM 必须是 en0 真实 MAC、换码风控纪律，以及正确顺序与救援路径。
plugins.description_en: Full workflow for switching the SMBIOS model and regenerating board serials on a hackintosh OpenCore setup — deciding whether to switch, the coupling conflict between the SMBIOS model and Apple's built-in USB maps, the system-volume rebuild caused by a new board-id, why CPUFriendDataProvider must be rebuilt in the same change, serial/MLB/UUID generation with the three-class validity check, why ROM must be the real en0 MAC, account-flagging discipline, and the correct order with a rescue path.
